name: Corte
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Corte is an AI media platform: create, edit, automate and publish brand media in one workspace. Connect it and describe the outcome; ChatGPT does the work in your Corte projects.

Create: generate images, video, music, voiceover and sound effects in your brand's look and voice. Run one-click Applications like Product Reshoot and Virtual Try-On on your own photos.

Automate: start any of your Workflows, follow the run, and get the results back.

Publish: get a permanent public link for any asset. Create, translate and publish content. Spin up a Build site or app, talk to it, and deploy it.

Grow: draft social posts and campaigns for review, and see how they performed. A person approves or schedules social posts in Corte before anything is sent to a connected channel. Turn a product catalog into ready-to-run ads.

Follow your agents: see what your Corte agents did on each run and what they made.

Stay in control: everything lands in the project you choose, and shared projects bill the project owner. You approve exactly what ChatGPT can reach when you connect, and you can disconnect it anytime from Corte's Settings.
